title: Amazon offers Anthropic up to $20B more in funding

sources.quote: Additionally, we entered into a financing arrangement to make available to Anthropic an aggregate facility not to exceed $20.0 billion that will expire 30 months after an Anthropic liquidity event, including an initial public offering (“IPO”).

In May 2026 (unaudited), Amazon invested $5.0 billion in the Company’s Series H redeemable convertible preferred stock financing, which reduced the amount available for issuance under the Amazon 2026 NPA to $15.0 billion.

explain: Besides its $5 billion share purchase, Amazon set up a facility that lets Anthropic draw up to $20 billion more as Amazon delivers computing capacity. Amazon has already used $5 billion of it to join Anthropic's Series H round, leaving $15 billion.
